# Implementation Plan: Codex Experimental Feature Live Toggle No Restart

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-15. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan D:\harness-efforts\codexu\.ralph\jobs\codex-experimental-feature-live-toggle-no-restart\plan.md`.*

## Overview

Make exactly three Codex experimental features apply to the current TUI session after a user accepts changes in `/experimental`, without requiring process restart: `Feature::AnthropicModels`, `Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic`, and `Feature::UserMessageStyling`.

This is a targeted live-patch plan, not a general hot-reload framework. The implementation should reuse the existing `/experimental` persistence path and `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` live-patch seam, preserve all defaults and startup/config enable paths, and leave restart-bound and already-live features untouched.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

- Source of truth: `.ralph\investigations\codex-experimental-feature-live-toggle-no-restart\findings.md` and `.ralph\investigations\codex-anthropic-models-not-in-model-picker\findings.md`.
- Target repo for implementation: `D:\harness-efforts\codexu\codex\external\repos\codex-patched`. The impl phase should work directly in the canonical inner checkout on a fresh post-.9 accumulation branch; do not prescribe a worktree because local cargo cannot build from the codex inner worktree layout.
- `/experimental` currently persists feature updates before patching runtime/UI state. `App::update_feature_flags()` stages constrained feature updates, writes the config batch, installs `self.config = next_config`, and then calls `self.chat_widget.set_feature_enabled(feature, effective_enabled)` for each accepted update (`codex-rs\tui\src\app\config_persistence.rs:361-507`).
- `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` is explicitly bespoke live-patch code. It handles realtime, fast mode, personality, plugins, goals, mentions v2, prevent idle sleep, and Windows sandbox UI, but has no branches for `AnthropicModels`, `LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic`, or `UserMessageStyling` today (`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\settings.rs:70-132`).
- `Feature::AnthropicModels` already flows through config resolution into a process-global atomic model-provider gate (`codex-rs\core\src\config\mod.rs:2627-2630`; `codex-rs\model-provider\src\anthropic_gate.rs:35-45`). The Copilot `/models` endpoint reads that gate for cache identity and row filtering (`codex-rs\model-provider\src\copilot_models_endpoint.rs:175-183`, `:238-244`, `:253-276`).
- The remaining Anthropic live-toggle gap has two parts. First, `CopilotModelProvider::models_manager()` still creates `GatedModelsManager::wrap(..., anthropic_models_resolved())`, capturing the gate when the manager is constructed (`codex-rs\model-provider\src\copilot.rs:123-129`, `:141-148`; `codex-rs\model-provider\src\copilot\gated_models_manager.rs:17-44`, `:57-90`). Second, `/model` uses the bootstrap `Arc<ModelCatalog>` rather than asking app-server again (`codex-rs\tui\src\app_server_session.rs:237-263`; `codex-rs\tui\src\app.rs:754-795`; `codex-rs\tui\src\model_catalog.rs:4-16`; `codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\model_popups.rs:20-30`).
- App-server `model/list` already uses the models manager with `RefreshStrategy::OnlineIfUncached` (`codex-rs\app-server\src\models.rs:12-22`) and is reached by `CatalogRequestProcessor::model_list()` (`codex-rs\app-server\src\request_processors\catalog_processor.rs:141-148`), so the TUI hook can reuse the bootstrap request shape instead of adding a new app-server API.
- `Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic` is resolved into `Config.disable_paste_burst = !features.enabled(Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic)` (`codex-rs\core\src\config\mod.rs:2631-2633`) and only passed to `BottomPane::new()` during `ChatWidget` construction (`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\constructor.rs:100-107`). The composer already has the safe runtime setter that updates the flag and defuses in-flight burst state when disabling (`codex-rs\tui\src\bottom_pane\chat_composer.rs:922-949`). A small `BottomPane` passthrough plus a `set_feature_enabled()` branch is enough.
- `Feature::UserMessageStyling` is installed once during `ChatWidget` construction (`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\constructor.rs:37-40`). The style gate itself is already atomic and read at render-style call sites (`codex-rs\tui\src\style.rs:56-83`), with tests for both enabled and disabled styling (`codex-rs\tui\src\style.rs:232-292`). The missing piece is a live `install_user_message_styling(enabled)` call from `set_feature_enabled()` plus redraw.
- Patch-surface registration belongs in `codex\external\repos\codex-patched\docs\implementation\patch-surface.md` under the existing §17 "Fork runtime flags migrated to experimental features" entry, which already lists the relevant surfaces and verification (`docs\implementation\patch-surface.md:51-84`).

### Technical Constraints

- Minimize upstream-canonical conflict surface. Prefer existing fork seams: `model-provider/src/copilot/gated_models_manager.rs`, `tui/src/app/config_persistence.rs`, `tui/src/app_server_session.rs`, and `tui/src/chatwidget/settings.rs`. Mark new upstream-canonical edits with `// SANDBOX PATCH:` and update `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md`.
- Do not build a general feature observer/subscriber registry. `Session.features` is documented as lifetime-invariant and config refresh explicitly leaves derived feature gates session-static; this plan must not promise generic live toggles for core/session consumers.
- Defaults and existing startup/CLI/config enable paths stay unchanged. This plan only makes mid-session accepted `/experimental` changes affect the current TUI process for the three named features.
- The Anthropic model toggle should handle both directions. Enabling must make Claude/chat-completions rows eligible in `/model` within the same session when Copilot returns them. Disabling must remove those rows from the current picker catalog and protect the current selected model if it is a now-unavailable Claude/Anthropic slug.
- UI-impacting changes need `codex-tui` tests and snapshots only if rendered output changes. The user-message styling toggle changes existing style selection, not copy; prefer a focused unit/widget test over broad snapshot churn unless a snapshot is already the local convention for the target surface.

## Approach

### Architecture

Add three targeted live patches behind the existing `/experimental` update flow:

1. **Anthropic model gate:** make the fork-specific `GatedModelsManager` consult the current Anthropic gate value when filtering instead of using a construction-time bool, then refresh the TUI model catalog after a successful `Feature::AnthropicModels` config write.
2. **Legacy paste burst:** extend `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` so `Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic` updates the composer runtime flag via a `BottomPane` passthrough to `ChatComposer::set_disable_paste_burst(!enabled)`.
3. **User message styling:** extend `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` so `Feature::UserMessageStyling` calls `crate::style::install_user_message_styling(enabled)` and requests a redraw.

The Anthropic work crosses model-provider plus TUI/app-server-session ownership, but it remains targeted: no app-server protocol change, no core/session feature re-derive, and no general framework.

Ordering invariant for US-001: production filtering must read the process-global `anthropic_models_resolved()` gate. `/experimental` already persists through `write_config_batch(...).await`, whose app-server config reload re-resolves config and re-installs that global gate before the awaited write returns. Therefore the model catalog refresh must run only after the config write succeeds; otherwise the refresh can observe the old gate.

### Implementation Strategy

1. In the canonical inner checkout, create a fresh post-.9 accumulation branch from the correct base. Do not create a codex inner worktree for implementation.
2. Update `codex-rs\model-provider\src\copilot\gated_models_manager.rs` so production filtering reads `anthropic_models_resolved()` live. Use a private, local flippable test seam if needed (for example, shared filter logic with a production `Global` source and an injected `Arc<AtomicBool>` source in tests) so tests can assert post-construction on/off behavior without mutating the process-global gate. Preserve fail-closed behavior for Claude/chat-completions rows when disabled.
3. Refactor the bootstrap model-list request mapping in `codex-rs\tui\src\app_server_session.rs` into a helper used by both `bootstrap()` and the new live refresh path. The helper should issue the same `ClientRequest::ModelList { include_hidden: Some(true) }`, map API rows with `model_preset_from_api_model`, compute `bootstrap_default_model(config.model.as_deref(), &available_models)`, and update `self.default_model` / `self.available_models` consistently.
4. Add an Anthropic-specific branch in `App::update_feature_flags()` after the config write succeeds and `self.config = next_config`. Capture `anthropic_models_changed` before consuming `feature_updates_to_apply` in the existing loop. If any accepted update is `Feature::AnthropicModels`, call the `AppServerSession` refresh helper, create a new `Arc<ModelCatalog>`, assign it to `App.model_catalog`, update `ChatWidget` through a new catalog setter, refresh model-dependent surfaces, and request redraw.
5. Add a `ChatWidget` catalog setter in an existing settings/module seam rather than growing `chatwidget.rs`. It should replace `self.model_catalog`, refresh the active collaboration mask and model-dependent surfaces, and leave selected non-Claude custom models alone when they remain valid by the same bootstrap policy. If the current effective model is a now-unavailable Claude/Anthropic slug after disable, explicitly update the active model through an existing application seam such as `ChatWidget::set_model()` (`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\settings.rs:266-279`) or `apply_model_and_effort_without_persist()` (`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\model_popups.rs:564-571`) so the next turn does not remain pinned to an unavailable chat-completions route. Add an info message for that fallback.
6. Add a `BottomPane::set_disable_paste_burst(disabled: bool)` passthrough near the other composer flag setters. Then add a `Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic` branch in `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` that passes `!enabled` because the feature enables the legacy heuristic while the composer field disables it.
7. Add a `Feature::UserMessageStyling` branch in `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` that calls `crate::style::install_user_message_styling(enabled)` and requests redraw so already-renderable rows pick up the atomic style gate on the next frame.
8. Update `codex-rs\tui\src\bottom_pane\chat_composer.rs` module docs only if the implementation changes the documented paste-burst semantics; otherwise sanity-check that the existing `disable_paste_burst` live-toggle text remains accurate.
9. Update `docs\implementation\patch-surface.md` §17 with the new live-toggle invariant, edited surfaces, and tests.
10. Run targeted verification from `D:\harness-efforts\codexu\codex\external\repos\codex-patched\codex-rs`: `just fmt`, `just test -p codex-model-provider`, `just test -p codex-tui`, and `cargo check --workspace` if the branch changes shared interfaces or the implementer wants the standard codex Phase-5a gate.

## Scope

### In Scope

- `Feature::AnthropicModels` accepted in `/experimental` refreshes the current TUI model catalog without restart.
- `/model` in the same TUI session reflects the new Anthropic gate state after enable and after disable.
- `Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic` accepted in `/experimental` immediately toggles the composer paste-burst heuristic for future input, including defusing buffered burst state when disabling.
- `Feature::UserMessageStyling` accepted in `/experimental` immediately changes user/proposed-plan styling on the next redraw.
- Focused model-provider and TUI tests plus patch-surface registration.

### Out of Scope

- General "all experimental features hot-reload" framework or feature subscriber registry.
- Core/session re-derive work for `Session.features` or restart/new-session-bound consumers.
- Restart-bound or new-session-bound features including `AutoLoadClaudeMd`, `WindowsGitBashShell`, `NetworkProxy`, `BackgroundProcessNotification`, `ExternalMigration`, `McpServerNotifications`, `ManagedHooks`, and most core/session consumers.
- Already-live features (`TerminalResizeReflow`, `RetainedTranscriptViewport`, `MentionsV2`, `PreventIdleSleep`).
- Changing feature defaults, CLI/config enable syntax, model endpoint predicates, or Copilot account availability behavior.
- Adding a new app-server protocol method.

## Risk Areas

- **Anthropic selected-model fallback:** disabling the gate while the current model is Claude must not leave the current thread on an unavailable chat-completions route. Reuse the bootstrap unavailable-Claude fallback policy.
- **Global gate testing:** model-provider tests should avoid process-global Anthropic gate races. Prefer a private injected/test gate in `GatedModelsManager` rather than mutating `install_anthropic_gate()` across parallel tests.
- **TUI catalog ownership:** `App.model_catalog` and `ChatWidget.model_catalog` must stay in sync; model-dependent surfaces and collaboration masks must refresh after replacement.
- **Config write failures/overrides:** runtime patching must remain after durable config success only. `WriteStatus::OkOverridden` should continue to avoid claiming a live state that effective config did not apply.
- **Anthropic refresh latency/offline behavior:** changing the gate changes the cache identity, so `RefreshStrategy::OnlineIfUncached` can perform a live `/models` request per toggle. Surface errors explicitly rather than silently presenting a stale catalog.
- **Paste config snapshot:** the paste live branch updates the active composer runtime state. `self.config.disable_paste_burst` may remain a derived startup snapshot; do not use it as the source of truth for current composer behavior after a live toggle.
- **Upstream conflict:** `app_server_session.rs`, `app/config_persistence.rs`, and `chatwidget/settings.rs` are upstream-canonical seams. Keep edits small, marked, and registered.
- **Network/account variance:** the Anthropic acceptance test can unit-test catalog/filter behavior, but a manual smoke is still needed because actual Claude rows depend on Copilot `/models` response contents.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. With a Copilot `/models` response containing a picker-enabled Claude/chat-completions row, toggling `Feature::AnthropicModels` on in `/experimental` and accepting the popup makes that Claude row appear in `/model` in the same TUI process without restart.
2. Toggling `Feature::AnthropicModels` off in `/experimental` and accepting the popup removes Claude/Anthropic chat-completions rows from `/model` in the same TUI process without restart.
3. If the current selected model is a now-unavailable Claude/Anthropic slug when `Feature::AnthropicModels` is disabled, the current session falls back to the refreshed catalog default (or another bootstrap-equivalent safe model) without persisting a misleading success state.
4. Model-provider tests prove `GatedModelsManager` responds to gate changes after construction for `list_models`, `try_list_models`, `raw_model_catalog`, `get_remote_models`, `try_get_remote_models`, `get_default_model`, and `get_model_info`, using a flippable injected test gate rather than the process-global gate.
5. TUI tests prove a successful `/experimental` update for `Feature::AnthropicModels` requests a fresh model list after the config write returns, swaps both App and ChatWidget catalogs, refreshes model-dependent surfaces, and updates the active model when the prior Claude/Anthropic selection becomes unavailable.
6. Toggling `Feature::LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic` on in `/experimental` makes future key streams use the legacy paste-burst heuristic in the same session; toggling it off bypasses the heuristic in the same session and flushes/clears any in-flight burst state through the existing composer setter.
7. TUI tests prove the paste-burst live branch maps feature enabled -> `disable_paste_burst = false` and feature disabled -> `disable_paste_burst = true`.
8. Toggling `Feature::UserMessageStyling` in `/experimental` changes `user_message_style()` and `proposed_plan_style()` output on the next redraw in the same process, with tests covering enabled and disabled transitions through `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()`.
9. Restart behavior remains unchanged for all three features: the same config/default/CLI paths still resolve the startup state as before.
10. The implementation does not modify restart-bound or already-live features and does not add a general hot-reload framework.
11. New upstream-canonical edits are marked with `// SANDBOX PATCH:` and `docs\implementation\patch-surface.md` §17 records the new live-toggle invariant and enforcing tests.
12. `just fmt`, `just test -p codex-model-provider`, and `just test -p codex-tui` pass from `codex-rs`. If shared interfaces are changed, `cargo check --workspace` is run as the codex Phase-5a gate.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

### US-001: Anthropic model catalog live refresh

As a Codex user, I want `AnthropicModels` changes accepted in `/experimental` to refresh `/model` immediately so that Claude rows appear or disappear without restarting the TUI.

Key work:
- Make `GatedModelsManager` read the Anthropic gate live after construction.
- Reuse/factor app-server-session model-list bootstrap logic for live refresh.
- Swap `App` and `ChatWidget` model catalogs after successful config writes.
- Apply bootstrap-equivalent fallback when disabling hides the current Claude model.
- Add model-provider and TUI tests.

### US-002: Legacy paste-burst heuristic live toggle

As a Codex user, I want `LegacyPasteBurstHeuristic` changes accepted in `/experimental` to affect the current composer immediately so that I can enable or disable the heuristic without restarting.

Key work:
- Add a `BottomPane` passthrough to `ChatComposer::set_disable_paste_burst()`.
- Extend `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` with the correct inverted mapping.
- Add a focused test and keep bottom-pane docs aligned.

### US-003: User message styling live toggle

As a Codex user, I want `UserMessageStyling` changes accepted in `/experimental` to redraw current-session styling immediately so that the visual toggle takes effect without restarting.

Key work:
- Extend `ChatWidget::set_feature_enabled()` to install the style gate and request redraw.
- Add a focused test that toggles through the widget path and observes `user_message_style()` / `proposed_plan_style()` output.

## Suggested Decomposition

The implementation should run serially despite having per-feature stories. All three stories touch `codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\settings.rs`, and US-001 also changes shared TUI catalog state. Serial execution minimizes conflict and lets the final test pass validate the combined `/experimental` handler behavior.

### Cluster: anthropic-model-catalog-live-refresh

- Stories: US-001
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\settings.rs`, `codex-rs\tui\src\app\config_persistence.rs`]; exclusive=[`codex-rs\model-provider\src\copilot\gated_models_manager.rs`, `codex-rs\model-provider\src\copilot.rs`, `codex-rs\tui\src\app_server_session.rs`, model catalog TUI tests]; risk=high
- `execution_mode` rationale: This cluster owns the riskiest state transition and establishes the catalog setter seam that later TUI-only toggles should not conflict with.

### Cluster: paste-burst-live-toggle

- Stories: US-002
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: anthropic-model-catalog-live-refresh
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\settings.rs`]; exclusive=[`codex-rs\tui\src\bottom_pane\mod.rs`, `codex-rs\tui\src\bottom_pane\chat_composer.rs`, paste-burst focused tests]; risk=medium
- `execution_mode` rationale: This is small but shares the same live-patch handler as US-001, so it should land after the handler shape is settled.

### Cluster: user-message-styling-live-toggle

- Stories: US-003
- Phase: 3
- Depends on: paste-burst-live-toggle
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`codex-rs\tui\src\chatwidget\settings.rs`]; exclusive=[`codex-rs\tui\src\style.rs`, styling focused tests]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: This is the smallest toggle and can be added last to the same handler with minimal risk after the prior two branches exist.

## Plan Review Summary

Phase-4 critique found 3 Medium issues and 0 High/Critical issues. All 3 were fixed in this plan:

- M1 clarified the linchpin Anthropic ordering invariant: production filtering reads the global `anthropic_models_resolved()` gate after the awaited config write re-installs it.
- M2 made the model-provider test seam concrete: use a flippable injected gate for post-construction behavior tests instead of mutating the global gate.
- M3 required the disabled-Claude fallback to update the active model, not only the catalog, and cited the existing seams to do it.

## Open Questions

- The actual Copilot account may or may not receive Claude rows from `GET https://api.githubcopilot.com/models`. Unit tests should use fixture data to prove the live-toggle seam; manual smoke should state "if Copilot returns a Claude row" for appearance behavior.
- The implementer should decide whether an open model picker is closed/reopened or simply redraws after catalog refresh. Acceptance only requires `/model` reopened in the same session to reflect the new catalog.
